# Device regressions check that a reused revision with a different place ID, a replay at a different name, and a delete that keeps the place ID do not let a lost rename override newer server state.
# Consecutive renames and a process restart after a listing check that verified move history lets the user's original rename reach the server again.
# The engine tests isolate the record fields and cover the move out of the trash; the pinned-release upgrade case covers both old rows with no proof and durable move history with more than one base.
